title: Entity Outcome enforces its tenant-scoped identity, invariant and lifecycle for consumers
risk: A consumer reads or writes Outcome through a path that crosses the tenant boundary or ignores the invariant, so a wrong or foreign record becomes the basis of a customer-facing statement.
preconditions: Tenant T1 seeded in run-t1-unit-ent-outcome with the fixture record for Outcome identified by its business key
A tenant T2 record with an equivalent business key exists so cross-tenant reads can be attempted

inputs.invariant_under_test: an outcome is reconciled against the system-of-record numbers before it counts
inputs.refused_violation: an outcome disagreeing with the ERP mirror is flagged for reconciliation and never silently accepted
inputs.downstream_consumer_read: the KPI read returns only reconciled revenue and marks the flagged outcome

steps.action: Read and re-write the Outcome record through the tenant-scoped repository/service using the fixture business key
steps.expected: the record round-trips with tenant_id T1, an immutable id and the business key intact

steps.action: Exercise the consumer path named for this entity
steps.expected: the consumer observes the invariant: an outcome is reconciled against the system-of-record numbers before it counts

the write is rejected with an explicit domain error and leaves no partial row, no orphan child and no side effect (an outcome disagreeing with the ERP mirror is flagged for reconciliation and never silently accepted)

steps.action: Repeat the read with the T2 tenant scope and with a caller lacking authority for this entity
steps.expected: T1 data is not returned, the T2 copy is unchanged and the denial is recorded rather than silently emptied

assertions: The persisted record carries tenant_id T1 and unique identity under (tenant_id, outcome_id, reconciliation source)
The consumer path reflects the invariant: an outcome is reconciled against the system-of-record numbers before it counts

The refused operation returns an explicit error naming the rule, and the prior state is byte-identical afterwards: an outcome disagreeing with the ERP mirror is flagged for reconciliation and never silently accepted
The T2 read returns no T1 row and the T1 read returns no T2 row
forbidden: Accepting the refused operation, or applying it partially before the error: an outcome disagreeing with the ERP mirror is flagged for reconciliation and never silently accepted
Returning, joining or counting another tenant's row on any consumer path of Outcome
evidence: Repository read/write responses for both tenants including the business-key and tenant_id fields
Error code and message of the refused operation plus the unchanged row snapshot taken before and after
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped Outcome rows and their child rows under run-t1-unit-ent-outcome; keep the fixture and the denial audit entry
automation: Drive the repository/service API with the fixture payloads and assert on the returned projection, the error code of the violation and the cross-tenant read; the entity contract is enforced at the service boundary, so no DDL introspection is needed.
